did.unittitle: Population Council records, Publications, RG 2, Series 19

physdesc.extent: 33 total containers including: 87 letter document boxes, 8 standard record storage boxes, and 2 legal document box.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series is primarily comprised of Population Council annual reports, Policy Research Division working papers, and the Population and Development Review and select associated supplements. Also included are a variety of reports, surveys, technical reports and analysis published and/or otherwise sponsored or supported by the Population Council in the areas of reproductive health, family planning, support for women and girls, HIV and AIDS, population policy, and sexual or gender-based violence.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Level 1: File-Level Access. Many records remain in original housing.
